newsitem.title: USA: TCC Industries continues strategic search.
newsitem.headline: TCC Industries continues strategic search.

text.p: TCC Industries Inc said Wednesday its efforts to find a strategic acquisition have been unsuccessful and it has hired an investment banker to evaluate all strategic alternatives.

The company said its investment banker, Rauscher Pierce Refsnes, is to review all alternatives, including material acquisition of or merger with another company, the sale of all or part of the company, or a leveraged buyout by mangaement and/or new investors.

TCC Chairman and Chief Executive Lawrence Schumann also said in a statement that the increased loss for the company's 1996 fiscal year is partially the result of increased selling, general and administrative expenses.
For the fiscal year ended December 31, the company reported a net loss of $1.54 million, or $0.56 per share, compared to a net loss of $90,000, or $0.03 per share.
